description: Roll out an Index Lifecycle Management (ILM) policy on a 20-node OpenSearch cluster managing 200 indices (2TB). The policy defines hot→warm→cold→delete tiers: hot (SSD, 0-7 days), warm (HDD, 7-30 days), cold (compressed, 30-90 days), delete (after 90 days). The rollout must include: define the ILM policy, configure node attr-based tier allocation (hot/warm/cold node pools), set up index rollover (max_size 50GB or max_age 1d), re-point aliases to the new managed indices, and verify the policy is active (ILM explain API). A rollback plan must exist (detach policy, revert to manual index management). Risk factors: moving shards between tiers causes I/O load, rollover changes the active write index (applications using direct index names will break), and delete phase can remove data if retention is misconfigured. Tools available: opensearch-cli, curl, jq, OpenSearch Dashboards, ILM Explain API.
